standard_prerequisites.name: The compatibility of the pullback with colimits and its right exactness
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof at source lines 1314-1315 as a pointer to a lemma of this chapter
standard_prerequisites.use: Transports the presentation to the pullback.

core_obligations: Reduce to a presentation: arguing as in the proof of the corresponding statement for locally generated modules, the proof assumes the module has a global presentation by direct sums of copies of the structure sheaf (proof lines 1311-1313)

Apply the pullback: since the pullback commutes with colimits and is right exact, applying it to the presentation produces a presentation of the pulled back module by direct sums of copies of the structure sheaf of the source (proof lines 1314-1339)
Conclude: such a presentation is precisely quasi-coherence (proof lines 1340)
proof_roadmap: 与 lemma-pullback-locally-generated 的证明同样地化归，可设 G 有整体展示 ⊕_{j∈J}O_Y → ⊕_{i∈I}O_Y → G → 0。
因为 f^* 与 colim 交换且右正合（本章引理），作用后得 ⊕_{j∈J}O_X → ⊕_{i∈I}O_X → f^*G → 0，即 f^*G 拟凝聚。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that the pullback of a quasi-coherent module is quasi-coherent (author lemma at source lines 1302-1308, label lemma-pullback-quasi-coherent). The proof (source lines 1310-1341) reduces, by the argument of the corresponding statement for modules generated by sections, to a module with a global presentation by direct sums of copies of the structure sheaf, and then transports the presentation along the pullback using its compatibility with colimits and its right exactness (proof lines 1311-1339). The reduction and the transport of the presentation are the content. H2.
